verdict.rationale: Make documents a REST API reference with per-resource endpoint pages (connections, data stores, analytics, AI agents), but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer, a "try it" console or runnable examples. The probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path. A static endpoint reference is an adjacent feature, not the interactive, runnable reference this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
